the India routes at their edges (feature india) > [IN-30] the issue check asks for each export destination named, leaving out IN; with none named it asks for none

the India routes at their edges (feature india) > [PR-43] [IN-31] [IN-18] the label of a batch gives the database's particulars, a tentative shelf life as such; an unknown batch is not found; the register keeps to its period
the India routes at their edges (feature india) > [IN-27] a hazard record that names neither a product classification nor an area dedication is refused with what to do
the India routes at their edges (feature india) > [IN-27] a product classification alone or an area dedication alone is recorded and listed with all it says
the India routes at their edges (feature india) > [IN-30] the signed approval (INDIA_ACT) answers with the act and the record it approved

licences and export permissions over HTTP (Phase 4 slice 6a) > [IN-30] the regulatory signer records a licence; it shows as DRAFT and the check refuses the product until QA approves it; the issuer may not record one
licences and export permissions over HTTP (Phase 4 slice 6a) > [IN-30] INDIA_ACT: QA approves a licence and an export permission through the signing ceremony, never the recorder
licences and export permissions over HTTP (Phase 4 slice 6a) > [IN-30] an export permission recorded over HTTP counts once approved, until it is suspended; IN is never a destination

the record side over HTTP (Phase 4 slice 6a) > [IN-18][IN-31][PR-43] an issued batch is in the allocation register with its licence; its label particulars and H2 payload come from the record; a payload is issued on the batch and verified, another refused
